environment.scope: Existing explicit source environment. Versions are receipt-time observations; support-library source checkouts are not included in this native/addon freeze. No environment solve, new backend build or clean installed qualification.

implemented.signature: Native primary omitted, scientific parameters/defaults preserved, plus keyword-only update_view=True and addon-only skip_digestion=False. Native function has no skip parameter; ordinary native validation is always used.
implemented.ownership: Native in-place None return. No invented in_place control, independent result, molecular-system argument or root alias. Requires loaded coordinates and open owner.
implemented.effects: Retained atom/structure/chemical identity; selected stored coordinates, native per-structure B-factor sets and global atom-ID labels. Native alternate-site records remain and analysis invalidation follows actual coordinate publication. Source correspondence uses retained indices, not labels.
implemented.binding: Native location list binds sorted unique selected atoms; the first processed selected structure chooses each global atom label. Nonconsecutive structure order remains native and no visible structure is substituted.
implemented.noop: No selected-site publication preserves revision/history/coverage; update_view=True may still synchronize prior pending work. Equal numerical values alone do not establish no-op.
implemented.failure_receiving: The reviewed native route publishes protected coordinates before any metadata writes. With loaded coordinates, an unchanged geometry publication token certifies a clean rejection; a changed token on error enters uncertain state and requires explicit replacement. Native error classes/messages remain.
implemented.sync_retry: A separate scene failure carries science_completed=True/scientific_result=None. Real native-call profiling across a transport failure plus retry observes one scientific call; retries only reconstruct projection.
implemented.host: Existing generic coordinator is sufficient; no Viewer runtime logic or scientific algorithm changes.

qualification.cases: 30 focused cases cover explicit/tied/received higher-occupancy choices, location lists and selected/nonconsecutive structures, MolSysMT/MDTraj syntax, physical quantities in nm/angstrom/pm and squared lengths, native B-factor admission, alternate metadata retention, native and integration validation including local skip, unchanged chemistry/source/index handles, analysis coverage, no-ops, partial native failure and explicit recovery, removal composition, lifetime/replacement and projection-only retry.
qualification.crystallographic_control: Bundled Barnase-Barstar 1brs BCIF sites 2686/2687 resolve B to IDs 2688/2690 and literal nm coordinates [[3.2757,2.2571,0.1533],[3.3396,2.192,0.2619]], atol=1e-12, without invented chemistry or coordinate preparation.
